_comment: Generic hidden-Markov-model tool. AutoForm over HmmViewModel: a settings dock (trace files, state count, covariance type, EM controls) and a result dock with the trace + decoded path, the intensity histogram with the fitted emissions, dwell-time histograms, the state table, the transition matrix and the state-count scan. All plots go through the AutoForm plot section, which renders with chiplot.

sections.title: Traces
sections.description: Binned trace files: rows are time bins, columns are detection channels. Several files are fitted jointly as separate sequences.

sections.label: States
sections.description: Number of hidden states. Use the state scan below rather than guessing — the likelihood always improves with more states, the information criteria do not.

sections.label: Covariance
sections.description: Shape of the emission covariance: full = an unrestricted matrix per state; diag = one variance per channel; spherical = one variance per state; tied = one matrix shared by all states. Fewer parameters are more stable on short traces.

sections.label: Bin width (s)
sections.description: Duration of one time bin. Dwell times and transition rates are reported in these units; leave at 1 to report them in bins.

sections.label: Max EM maps
sections.description: Upper bound on Baum-Welch maps. With acceleration, one SQUAREM cycle spends three.

sections.label: Tolerance
sections.description: Stop once the log-likelihood gain per iteration falls below this.

sections.label: Accelerate (SQUAREM)
sections.description: Extrapolate the EM fixed-point iteration (Varadhan & Roland scheme S3). Same optimum, far fewer maps when the states overlap.

sections.label: Decoder
sections.description: viterbi = the single most probable state path (self-consistent, what dwell times need); map = the most probable state in each bin taken independently.

sections.label: Seed
sections.description: Seed of the k-means initialisation. A fixed seed makes the fit reproducible.

buttons.label: ▶ Fit
buttons.description: Fit the model with the chosen number of states and decode the state path.

buttons.label: ⇄ Scan states
buttons.description: Fit every state count in the range and score each by AIC and BIC.

sections.title: Trace and decoded states
sections.description: The binned trace with the decoded state path drawn over it: each bin at the total emission mean of the state it was assigned to.

sections.title: Intensity histogram
sections.description: Histogram of the summed intensity with the fitted emission densities, each scaled by its state's occupancy. Overlapping curves mean the states are not resolved by intensity alone — the transition structure is then what separates them.

sections.title: Dwell times
sections.description: Dwell-time histogram per state. A single exponential (a straight line on this log axis) is what a Markov state predicts; curvature means the state hides substructure.

sections.title: State-count scan
sections.description: AIC and BIC against the number of states. Take the minimum, not the elbow of the likelihood; BIC charges more per parameter and usually gives the model a kinetic interpretation can carry.
